content.text:
The member at the front of the hold queue can now check the item out, even when others are queued behind them. Members behind the front are still refused with `on-hold`. All 61 tests pass, including the new one.

`findBlockingHold` in `lib/holds/queue.js` used to return any active hold belonging to another member. The front member was therefore blocked by whoever queued after them. It now looks only at the front of `holdQueue` (the earliest-placed active hold). It returns that hold when it belongs to someone else, and `null` when there are no holds or the front hold is the member's own.

I added a test in `test/checkout.test.js`. It queues ADA first and BEN second. ADA can check the item out, and BEN is refused.

I didn't touch `lib/circulation/checkout.js`, and the existing hold tests didn't need changes.
